title: Prognostic Recovery Observations and Guidance for Evaluating Stroke Survivors
official: Prognostic Recovery Observations and Guidance for Evaluating Stroke Survivors
summary: This research delves into the acute prognostic factors influencing functional recovery in individuals who have experienced a stroke. The objective is to describe patterns of functional recovery after a stroke and identify new, clinically significant outcomes or metrics that can serve as predictive indicators for post-stroke functional recovery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18
* Haemorrhagic or ischaemic stroke confirmed by a clinical diagnosis and by brain imaging
* NIHSS item 5-6 ≥1
* 3 to 10 days post-stroke

Exclusion Criteria:

* Transient ischaemic attack
* Premorbid Modified Rankin Scale ≥ 4
* Acute orthopaedic complications
* Inability to give informed consent
